name: Eric Sorensen
bio: a Representative from Illinois; born in Rockford, Winnebago County, Ill., March 18, 1976; graduated from Boylan Central Catholic High School, Rockford, Ill., 1994; B.S., Northern Illinois University, DeKalb, Ill., 1999; meteorologist; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Eighteenth and to the succeeding Congress (January 2023-present).
